start: ^School is over. You're at the bus stop, waiting for the E3.
^The pavement is crammed with kids from school, kicking and shoving, in their smart, orange-striped navy blazers.
^A kitkat wrapper flutters in the drain.
haribos: ^You buy Haribos. They are tough, chewy, like sour rubber, they taste like the synthetic average of different fruit, combinations of malic and citric acid singeing your tongue. Your jaw hurts from chewing but you keep stuffing one after another into your mouth.
^You feel excellent - the bus roars beneath you, bumping and gliding. You are flying.
^An hour later, at home, the energy crash comes. You're empty, heavy.
just_wait: ^When you were younger, you used to pray to Ethron, god of E3 buses. Did it work? You'd stand in the rain, looking at the bend in the road where the bus would come, desperately praying for Ethron to send you an E3. It seemed to help. The bright red double decker bus would swing round the corner, emblazoned on the front: E3.
^You stare at the bend, tapping your fingers on your thigh.
open_youtube: ^The thumbnails shine like candies - bright colours, shocked faces.
^You click, turn down the volume. You get out your earphones, unwind the white tacky strings, and plug them in. You fix the little plastic bobbles in your ears.
^You finish the video and press another thumbnail. It feels good.
